design_rationale: Development-only chronological comparison, not an unrestricted feature/hyperparameter search. Training uses the same 2010Q1 development-split rows and frozen predictor set already accepted in the original challenger (configs/challenger.json); this design changes only the model-selection validation set, from the same-cohort md5-hash internal_validation split to the full, chronologically later, previously-external 2011Q1 population, which the redevelopment plan explicitly permits to now inform development. This is the smallest change that lets development-only selection use out-of-cohort evidence before ever touching the 2012Q1 calibration or 2013Q1 final-test cohorts. No nonlinear terms or interactions are introduced; the same multinomial logistic form is reused.
training_split_note: Same md5(expanded-v1:+loan_id) split already frozen in expanded_features.py; only the 'development' partition (2010Q1, Jan 2011 snapshot) is used for fitting. The 'internal_validation' partition of 2010Q1 is reported for reference only and is NOT used for candidate selection in this design.
development_validation_note: 2011Q1, Jan 2012 snapshot, outcomes through Jan 2013 -- the population previously scored once as an external test (artifacts/runs/external_evaluation/bb53b87c6a034af29614c2c5768b4b06/, calibration failed, immutable). Reused here only for candidate selection during development, per the redevelopment plan's explicit permission; it is not evaluated again as an external test.
usage: Development-only model selection. Not calibration (2012Q1) and not final evaluation (2013Q1).
controls: Preprocessing (medians, scales, categories) fit on 2010Q1 development rows only.
Candidate set fixed before this run: three L2 regularization strengths plus the constant/smoothed benchmark family, identical to configs/challenger.json.
No hyperparameter or feature search beyond this fixed grid.
2012Q1 and 2013Q1 are not read by this step.
